55187.subject: Commerce
55187.question_text: A partnership may be automatically dissolved due to the following factors except________
55187.explanation: A partnership may be automatically dissolved due to events like a court verdict or the bankruptcy of a partner. A joint decision can also end the partnership. However, admission of new partners does not dissolve the partnership; it only leads to reconstitution.

55188.explanation: The lack specialization because the owner is personally involved in every section of the business.

From accounting equation;
Assets = Capital + liabilities

Liabilities = (4900 + 1600) - (500 + 1000) = 6500 - 6000

55210.subject: Commerce
